# PresentMon in Overseer

Overseer invokes the official x64 PresentMon 2.5.1 console executable as a separate child
process for optional ETW-based frame presentation monitoring. It consumes documented v2 CSV
output from standard output and does not inject code into monitored applications.

Source and releases: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon

Bundled binary SHA-256:
`9BEC3083069F58F911E6A512F4806DB51A27BD096103087BC1D05EF54C80A191`
